author: Rob Cummings
releaseNotes: 0.2.12: renamed to Weather Watcher (apps Weather Watcher Manager and Weather Watcher, driver Weather Watcher Device); existing apps, devices and settings are kept. 0.2.11: Monochrome (erikflowers) icon pack (new library) and night icons for today before sunrise and after sunset. 0.2.10: icon packs renamed to Rob's filled and Rob's outline. 0.2.9: Meteocons static and animated icon packs (two new libraries) and an Animate icons setting. 0.2.8: tile image always matches the latest update (stale in-memory copy after code updates); location name kept across updates. 0.2.7: after midnight the tile drops yesterday and refetches at about 00:02. 0.2.6: last-updated line shows location and time. 0.2.5: remove java.io class references the hub sandbox rejects. 0.2.4: robust JSON parsing of weather responses (fixes NWS points parse error). 0.2.3: icons stored as one small method per icon (hub could not parse the large @Field map). 0.2.2: fix "Cannot parse library definition" (simplified library() header). 0.2.1: fix library bundle (library() metadata first; icons split into two libraries). 0.2.0: icons moved to libraries. 0.1.0: first release.
